name: Vapi Assistant Hook (setup status into prompt)

parameters.query:
WITH me AS (
  SELECT u.id AS uid, u.company_id
    FROM users u
   WHERE u.id = NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '')::uuid
), scope AS (
  -- Three-way scope: logged-in user with a company -> that company;
  -- logged-in user with no company (onboarding) -> NULL, NOT company 1;
  -- no/invalid token (legacy client) -> company 1.
  SELECT me.uid,
         COALESCE(me.company_id, CASE WHEN me.uid IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS company_id
    FROM (SELECT 1) one
    LEFT JOIN me ON true
)
SELECT COALESCE(cp.setup_completed_at IS NOT NULL, false) AS setup_complete,
       COALESCE(cp.company_name, '')      AS company_name,
       COALESCE(cp.pm_preferred_name, '') AS pm_preferred_name,
       scope.company_id,
       COALESCE(scope.uid::text, '')      AS user_id,
       lc.ctx            AS last_call_ctx,
       lc.ended_at       AS last_call_ended_at,
       lc.ended_reason   AS last_call_ended_reason
  FROM scope
  LEFT JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = scope.company_id
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT right(COALESCE(vc.summary, vc.transcript), 900) AS ctx,
               vc.ended_at, vc.ended_reason
          FROM voice_calls vc
         WHERE vc.company_id = scope.company_id
           AND vc.status = 'reported'
           AND vc.ended_at > now() - interval '7 days'
           AND vc.ended_at < now() - interval '30 seconds'
         ORDER BY vc.ended_at DESC
         LIMIT 1
  ) lc ON true
 LIMIT 1;

WITH upd AS (
  UPDATE voice_calls
     SET status           = 'reported',
         vapi_call_id     = COALESCE($2, vapi_call_id),
         started_at       = COALESCE($3::timestamptz, started_at),
         ended_at         = COALESCE($4::timestamptz, ended_at),
         ended_reason     = COALESCE($5, ended_reason),
         duration_seconds = COALESCE($6, duration_seconds),
         summary          = COALESCE($7, summary),
         transcript       = COALESCE($8, transcript),
         messages         = COALESCE($9::jsonb, messages),
         updated_at       = now()
   WHERE $1::uuid IS NOT NULL
     AND call_ref = $1::uuid
   RETURNING id, call_ref, status
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO voice_calls (company_id, call_ref, vapi_call_id, status,
                           started_at, ended_at, ended_reason,
                           duration_seconds, summary, transcript, messages)
  SELECT 1,
         COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
         $2,
         'reported',
         COALESCE($3::timestamptz, now()),
         $4::timestamptz,
         CASE WHEN $1::uuid IS NULL THEN 'unmatched:' || COALESCE($5, 'unknown')
              ELSE $5 END,
         $6, $7, $8, $9::jsonb
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
     AND COALESCE($2, '') <> ''
  ON CONFLICT (vapi_call_id) DO UPDATE
     SET status       = 'reported',
         ended_at     = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ended_at, voice_calls.ended_at),
         ended_reason = COALESCE(voice_calls.ended_reason, EXCLUDED.ended_reason),
         transcript   = COALESCE(voice_calls.transcript, EXCLUDED.transcript),
         summary      = COALESCE(voice_calls.summary, EXCLUDED.summary),
         messages     = COALESCE(voice_calls.messages, EXCLUDED.messages),
         updated_at   = now()
  RETURNING id, call_ref, status
)
SELECT id, call_ref, status FROM upd
UNION ALL
SELECT id, call_ref, status FROM ins
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::bigint, NULL::uuid, 'none'::text
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd)
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins);

-- voice_calls.company_id and call_ref are both NOT NULL, so a caller with no
-- company yet (onboarding) has no pending row: the report then lands as
-- 'unmatched:' instead of failing the hook.
WITH scope AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(btrim($1::text), '')::smallint AS company_id
), ins AS (
  INSERT INTO voice_calls (company_id, call_ref)
  SELECT scope.company_id, gen_random_uuid() FROM scope
   WHERE scope.company_id IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING call_ref
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT call_ref::text FROM ins), '') AS call_ref;
